provenance: Synthetic: a bounded-concurrency map whose hidden cases are the concurrency cap, result order and no new work after the first failure. Authored for this harness.

task.name: Add a mapLimit helper
task.description: Add `mapLimit(items, limit, fn)` in `src/map-limit.mjs` as a named export. It calls `fn(item, index)` for every item with at most `limit` calls in flight at once and resolves to the results in input order. When a call rejects, the returned promise rejects with that error and no further calls are started. An empty input resolves to `[]`. A `limit` that is not an integer >= 1 throws a RangeError.
